verdict.rationale: The API uses version-prefixed paths such as /credit-cards/v1/cashback, which shows URL-based API versioning. The pack contains no documented deprecation policy, sunset timeline, changelog or version lifecycle guidance. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, versioning strategy documentation, changelog/sunset notices, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
